Added `reverse(text)` to `textkit/text.py`. It returns the text reversed (`text[::-1]`) and has the required doctest. `reverse` is also exported from `textkit` (import and `__all__`).

## Tests
I added 3 tests in `tests/test_text.py`: the basic case, edge cases (empty string, single character, spaces, double reverse) and the package export. `python3 -m unittest -q` passes (8 tests).
